notices.heading: Provisional model.
notices.text: Parcel A and Parcel B on this page are provisional analytical polygons, built from a family statement of c.1974 and later maps. They are not surveyed or conveyance-proven boundaries. They stay provisional until the 1876–78 Bute, Daniel Thomas and Williams instruments and the later deed and court plans are found and overlaid.
